channel.description: Latest articles from Sioux City Journal (siouxcityjournal.com)

item.title: City skimped on features at Tyson Events Center, officials say
item.description: The decision to skimp on certain features to open the Tyson Events Center in 2003 is coming back to bite the city.

item.title: Tea time: Steeped in history, leafy drink is attracting plenty of buzz
item.description: Every day, roast master Joel Lester is surrounded by the robust aroma of specialty coffee beans at Caturra Coffee Roasting Company.

item.title: GALLAGHER: Northwest Iowa church doors open amid political storm
item.description: The snow drifts on the shoulders of Highway 60 late Monday, a typical Northwest Iowa night this January.

item.title: Bancroft-Rosalie superintendent filmed in Japanese TV show
item.description: Jon Cerny has filled many roles in his career. Could Japanese TV star be the next addition to that list?

item.title: Trump addresses 1,700 in Sioux City, donates $100k to Siouxland Soldiers
item.description: In his last campaign rally in Siouxland before the Iowa caucuses Monday, Donald Trump spoke to about 1,700 inside the Orpheum Theatre Sunday, receiving a standing ovation when he announced a $100,000 donation to Support Siouxland Soldiers.

item.title: Hillary Clinton draws 500 in Sioux City push to Iowa caucuses
item.description: Democratic presidential candidate Hillary Clinton leaned heavily on wonkish policy details rather than attacks on other candidates as she sought in a Sunday stop to get Northwest Iowans to caucus for her Monday night.

item.title: KARSYN: Operation Prom gives away dresses to girls in need
item.description: Bedazzled bodices shimmer under the fluorescent lights. Abigail Barbee digs through massive poufs of taffeta and tulle in search of a sleek, classy prom dress to fit her 5-foot-10 frame.

item.title: Visiting the 9/11 Memorial: An unforgettable experience
item.description: A visit to the 9/11 Memorial Museum in New York's Financial District would be a refresher lesson – a look at history from a distance – I told myself.

item.title: Navigating the E-edition
item.description: The E-edition – your digital replica of the newspaper!It’s new and ready for you to read first thing EVERY morning, seven days a week. Take a look at this short video which shows you all of its features and benefits.

item.title: Your newspaper has been upgraded!
item.description: Bigger, better – and bursting with news: An expanded newspaper with more pages — that means more stories, pictures, sports news, opinion content, lifestyle features, and investigative reporting. More to learn. More to love. More to sit down with and…
